About this app +

Orbit Campaign Studio

The idea

The idea is to connect a campaign’s audience, message, creative, landing experience, and follow-up around one business brief.

The problem it addresses

Personas, ads, landing pages, and follow-up sequences can become disconnected during planning.

Who it helps

Marketers developing campaign ideas, creative, and measurement plans.

What you can do

Prototypes personas, articles, ads, landing-page copy, assessments, workbooks, and follow-up sequences using templates and optional AI generation.

The intended outcome

Build connected draft campaign assets from a business brief.

Created by SEO Girl - Ami. Review research, generated drafts, and illustrative examples before applying them.
